Run from the project workspace with wrapper.py at the path above.
On 2026-11-01 the recording workspace's real identities were replaced, in msg
and typed alike, by fixed fakes of the same length: owner name Owen Example
(first name Owen), owner user ID U0TESTUSER1, DM ID D0TESTDM001, channel ID
C0TESTCHAN1, channel name squad and bot user squad_dev_apiary. They use only
letters, digits, spaces and underscores, which the reference output shows pass
through its escaping unchanged, so every typed value and typed_len equals the
reference output for the substituted msg. No other byte changed.

escaping-edges.json reference.attributes/reference.bodies: inputs chosen from
SR-2.2; expected strings generated by wrapper.py escape_attr/escape_body using
Python 3.10.12 (Unicode 13.0.0), with runpy.run_path.

including its Default_Ignorable_Code_Point list, NFKC letter comparison and
explicit negative controls. Those expectations extend the Python reference.
Lone UTF-16 surrogate replacement is specified by SR-2.2 and tested separately.
No expected output was generated by the TypeScript formatter.
